lee-child-killing-floor.user_notes:
He uses hyper-short sentences (e.g., single-word sentences like "Friday."). Scenes are sparse, focusing on raw utility.
Gritty Realism. Settings are often monochromatic or muted—dusty highway diners, dim motels, sterile military offices, or stark neon-lit city streets at night.
The Archetypal Nomad. Characters (especially Reacher) are described through their clothes and physical presence rather than emotional expressions. Clothing is utilitarian (e.g., plain t-shirts, heavy boots).
Extreme Detail in Compressed Time. Child will spend three pages describing a 2-second physical altercation, noting structural weight, geometry, and impact.
